blocks.text:
After breakfast at the camp, you set out by boat for Congo.

Look for dolphins and northern screamers along the way.

After returning to camp, head to the port and continue by road into the Andes via La Azulita.

The route also takes you to a pirate cave and La Azulita Waterfall.

Lunch is in the village.

The drive then passes through cloud forest.

At higher elevations, you pass through Andean settlements.

Cacute holds an annual Candle Festival.

Mucuchíes is known for its breed of large, shaggy mountain dogs.

You also visit the Capilla de Piedras, a stone chapel and monument.

On the way through Santo Domingo, you can try the local trout.

On arrival at the estate, have dinner and relax.

Breakfast, lunch and dinner are included.
